documentation: One table, two implementations. `packages/api/src/onboarding.ts` decides whether a
first-run remote may be written to `Repo.remoteUrl`, and `apps/web/src/lib/onboarding.ts`
decides whether the wizard may send it at all. The control plane is authoritative; the
browser copy exists so a rejected remote is explained beside the field instead of
becoming a 400, and so a remote carrying a credential never leaves the page.
Neither may drift, so both suites drive their own parser with the cases below and
A first-run remote is a location. Accepted are credential-free `https://`, `ssh://` and
scp-like `[git@]host:path` remotes, plus `file:///` for the documented disposable
rehearsal. Refused is every shape that can persist authentication material or smuggle a
second command-line argument: any userinfo on https, any SSH account other than `git`,
any password, any query or fragment, any whitespace or control character anywhere, and
a leading dash. The raw string is judged; it is never trimmed first, because a leading
newline is one of the shapes being refused.
Reason codes are diagnostic and classification runs in the fixed precedence below, so
one value always yields one reason in both implementations.

accepted.description: HTTPS on a self-hosted host and port
scp-like with the one accepted SSH account
scp-like with no account at all
an explicit ssh:// URL naming the same account
the disposable rehearsal clones from a local bare repository

rejected.description: a personal access token pasted as the HTTPS user
user and password spelled out
the GitHub App spelling of the same thing
a token pasted where an scp-like login belongs
the same token through an explicit ssh:// URL
any SSH account other than git, because none of them is distinguishable from a token
a credential in the query string
a credential in the fragment
a leading newline, which is how a second argument is smuggled onto a command line
a trailing tab, refused rather than trimmed into acceptance
a leading space is still not part of the location
an interior space
an option wearing a location's clothes
a scheme this installation does not clone
not a remote at all
empty
file:// naming another machine
file:/// with no path
HTTPS with a host and no repository path
scp-like with an empty path
